planets.name: K2-266 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-266 with a 19.5-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-266 e was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-266. Its orbit and size follow Rodriguez et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
